# FireDEX Butler

> Water • Fire • Storm Restoration — 24/7 emergency response across Cranberry Township, Butler County and the Pittsburgh North suburbs since 1981.

FireDEX Butler (FireDEX Butler, Inc.) is a professional restoration contractor serving Cranberry Township, PA and surrounding areas since 1981. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (724) 452-7400 · Email: mail@firedex.net.
